components.name: Primary Download Action
components.description: The decisive website action: a clipped graphite control with an amber transfer edge.
components.html: Download CornerlightSigned and notarized DMG
components.css: .ds-download-action { position: relative; display: grid; min-width: 300px; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; column-gap: 24px; padding: 15px 16px 14px 18px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--silver-0); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1c2023, #101315 66%); border: 1px solid rgba(221,226,227,.42); clip-path: polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 15px) 0,100% 15px,100% 100%,0 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08),0 0 0 1px rgba(237,164,58,.08),0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.38); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease,transform 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-download-action::before { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 58%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--amber)); box-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(237,164,58,.58); content: ''; } .ds-download-action::after { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 15px; height: 15px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(237,164,58,.55); background: #21170c; content: ''; } .ds-download-action strong { display: block; font: 700 21px/1 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-download-action small { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--silver-2); font: 9px/1.4 'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-download-action svg { width: 22px; align-self: center; fill: none; stroke: var(--amber); stroke-linecap: square; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-download-action:hover { border-color: rgba(237,164,58,.72); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.1),0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.48); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-download-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--silver-0); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation Download
components.description: A compact secondary route to the release, framed by one satin rule.
components.css: .ds-nav-download { display: inline-block; padding: 9px 13px; color: var(--silver-0); border: 1px solid var(--silver-3); font: 12px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text',sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-download:hover { color: var(--silver-0); border-color: var(--amber); } .ds-nav-download:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--silver-0); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: System Plate
components.description: The near-flat clipped container for the website's inventory-to-native boundary diagram.
components.html:
SYSTEM HANDOFF / 001

The shortest path to native.

Three rootsCornerlightSystem-owned UI
components.css: .ds-system-plate { padding: 28px; color: var(--silver-0); background: linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(20,24,27,.88),rgba(8,10,11,.96)); border: 1px solid rgba(221,226,227,.32); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04),0 30px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.3); clip-path: polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 23px) 0,100% 23px,100% 100%,0 100%); } .ds-system-plate p { margin: 0; color: var(--silver-2); font: 600 11px/1.4 'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-system-plate h3 { margin: 3px 0 24px; font: 600 44px/.95 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-system-plate div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-top: 22px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--silver-1); font: 10px/1.4 'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-system-plate i,.ds-system-plate b { height: 1px; background: var(--silver-3); } .ds-system-plate b { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: 0 0 7px rgba(237,164,58,.5); } .ds-system-plate strong { font: 600 15px/1 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .025em; }

components.name: Technical Fact Strip
components.description: Compact quantitative facts separated by seams instead of cards.
components.css: .ds-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--silver-0); } .ds-facts div { padding: 14px 0 0; } .ds-facts div + div { padding-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-facts dt { color: var(--silver-2); font: 9px/1.4 'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-facts dd { margin: 3px 0 0; font: 600 21px/1 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .025em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
The website turns Cornerlight's narrow implementation boundary into a restrained technical artifact. A deep graphite field, satin-silver type and rules, and one amber transfer signal make the inventory-to-system handoff legible without imitating the product UI.

The world is precise, sparse, and nearly flat. Structure comes from alignment, seams, clipped corners, labels, and negative space rather than a collection of elevated containers.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite field with satin-silver structure and one restrained amber signal.
Condensed structural typography paired with calm system body text and compact monospaced labels.
Machined, clipped-corner controls and plates with sparse rules instead of rounded card chrome.
Image-native three-root convergence followed by an explicitly system-owned, abstract native handoff.
Responsive topology that changes the diagram and information flow instead of merely shrinking them.

rules.name: The Amber Transfer Rule
rules.body: Amber indicates passage, activation, or a decisive next step; it does not become a broad decorative fill or a second background system.

rules.name: The Native Restraint Rule
rules.body: The destination may suggest native macOS territory, but it remains an abstract diagram labeled as system-owned—never a fabricated Spotlight screenshot, invented result list, or alternate native interface.

rules.name: The Topology Rule
rules.body: Preserve sequence and meaning across breakpoints by changing structure and artwork orientation; do not scale a desktop diagram down until its labels fail.

rules.name: The Completed-State Rule
rules.body: With Reduced Motion enabled, remove smooth scrolling and collapse animation and transition durations to effectively immediate while rendering the handoff in its complete, fully opaque state.

dos: Do reserve amber for transfer, activation, primary action emphasis, and small status signals.
Do use sparse satin rules, alignment, and negative space to separate information.
Do preserve the three-root convergence and the restrained native handoff in every responsive orientation.
Do keep the website system explicitly separate from Spotlight's runtime-native ownership.
donts: Don't turn the page into a feature-card grid or a mosaic of interchangeable rounded panels.
Don't use fake native screenshots, invented launcher contents, or a website-built Spotlight lookalike.
Don't promote a route-specific first-viewport composition into the global website system; that composition belongs in its surface brief.
Don't spread amber across large surfaces or add ornamental glow that obscures the boundary story.
